method: Generated by scripts/modesty/gen.py from FMA7163 of public/models/skin.glb; the skin buffers are unchanged. Outer skin = triangles from which at least 3 of 96 outward rays escape. Genital skin = a graph min-cut on that outer skin seeded by inward rays (3 cm) that hit the external genital organs, with sinks where the skin leaves the genital ellipsoid or reaches the perineum and cheap cuts along concave creases, alternating with the outer test until stable. The suprapubic crease above the penis root is hidden with it. Drawn outer skin with a vertex within 50 mm of the hole's loop is the ring; ring and a minimum area + dihedral triangulation of the loop (Liepa 2003) form one mesh, from which ring triangles that are folded, non-manifold or wound against their neighbours near the loop, and the skin over the slot top that the scrotum covered, are removed and the holes capped; short edges near the loop are collapsed. Edges longer than 11 mm are split (longest-edge bisection) where the fill is mostly free and longer than 20 mm in the rest of the ring, new-fill edges Delaunay-flipped (source skin is never flipped across its facets), and the positions faired: umbrella bi-Laplacian plus a membrane term (weight 1, so the fill does not bulge past the skin), a pull towards the source skin that rises with geodesic distance from the loop to full at 50 mm (where the vertex keeps its source position), and a soft floor for downward-facing new fill within 20 mm of the midline that rises forward from y 0.729 m at z -0.01 m by 0.4 m per m; source skin that sinks below itself is held, folds are freed and refaired, and source skin over another drawn mesh that would come through stays put. Normals blend the source skin's interpolated normal and the patch geometry's by the same pull and are then diffused over 20 mm (screened Poisson, the patch edge held), so folds and facets of the fill leave no shading creases; fill crumpled against those normals is relaxed. Ring triangles that come through unchanged stay drawn skin; patch vertices that are skin vertices are written as the exact float32 skin coordinates, and those on drawn skin also take its float32 normal (no flange, no cracks). Genital inner-shell skin outside the patch or within 3 mm behind it is hidden. Male acupoint markers near the groin whose surface point is hidden or enclosed are re-cast onto the drawn surface ('anchors'). All patch triangles are counter-clockwise seen from outside.
limits: Editorial display surface, not anatomy: the patch is a smooth closure of the hole left by the penis and scrotum; it reconstructs no structure and implies nothing about real anatomy.

The closure spans the space between the inner thighs that the scrotum filled, so it closes a pocket of former open air behind and above it: new-fill vertices lie up to 25.3 mm from the original skin (largest distance from a new-fill vertex in the original's open air to the nearest original skin vertex); on the midline the original outer skin outside the genitals (the crease behind the scrotum) is up to 29.1 mm above the closure seen from below. The silhouette is not extended.

Seen from below on the midline (z = -1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5, 4 cm) the closure is at y 0.7286, 0.7314, 0.7352, 0.7364, 0.7420, 0.7426, 0.7438, 0.7440, 0.7433, 0.7446, 0.7484 m; the original perineum is at 0.7291 m at z = -1 cm, and the lowest closure point there is 0.5 mm below it. Forward of the perineum it dips by up to 0.8 mm before rising (a faired saddle over the slot top).

The male skin mesh is coarse in the groin (triangles up to several cm); the hidden outline follows existing skin edges and the faired ring blends into the kept facets. The stored patch normals are smoothed over 20 mm: the shading is smoother than the faceted geometry, whose small folds and corner dimples where the closure meets the thigh walls can still show on the silhouette.

Re-cast markers (surface point moved): ST30-0--1 0 mm, ST30-0-1 0 mm, SP12-0--1 0.3 mm, SP12-0-1 0.3 mm, KI11-0--1 0 mm, KI11-0-1 0 mm, KI12-0--1 0 mm, KI12-0-1 0 mm, LR10-0--1 40.7 mm, LR10-0-1 40.1 mm, LR11-0--1 44.5 mm, LR11-0-1 44 mm, LR12-0--1 0 mm, LR12-0-1 0 mm, CV2-0-1 0 mm, CV3-0-1 0 mm, EX-CA1-0--1 0 mm, EX-CA1-0-1 0 mm. Markers on skin the patch replaces follow its surface (under 1 mm); LR10-0--1, LR10-0-1, LR11-0--1, LR11-0-1 sat in the crease the scrotum sealed (already enclosed in the source mesh) and were moved straight forward onto the front of the closure, at the same side and height: an editorial placement on invented surface, not their anatomical site.

Genital organ meshes and the vessels and nerve that follow them out of the body lie outside the closed surface, so the runtime must hide them in this mode (src/modesty.ts); every other male mesh near the groin stays inside it.
Inner-shell skin of the genital core is hidden where it could show; its cut edges stay open inside the body.
Valid only for public/models/skin.glb with the sha256 above (triangle indices refer to FMA7163's index buffer). Male skin only.
